name: Z0109NN5AA4
title: Z01 series: 1 A standard triacs, 600 V or 800 V, in TO-92, SOT-223 and SMBflat-3L
summary: A family of 1 A rms triacs for general AC switching, blocking 600 V (M) or 800 V (N) in both directions. Four gate sensitivities set the maximum trigger current at 3, 5, 10 or 25 mA in quadrants I to III, a range offered so the gate can be driven directly from a microcontroller. Loads named for it include solenoid valves, pumps, door locks, small lamps and fan speed control. Z0109NN5AA4 is the 10 mA, 800 V part in SOT-223 on a 7-inch reel.

operation.text: The gate fires the triac in all four quadrants, with A2 and the gate each positive or negative against A1. For the Z0109 the trigger current limit is 10 mA in every quadrant; the Z0103 and Z0107 need a little more in quadrant IV (5 and 7 mA against 3 and 5 mA). Latching current is highest in quadrant II. Gate drive for the latching test is 1.2 times IGT.

From Z0103 to Z0110 the minimum static dV/dt rises from 10 to 100 V/µs and the minimum (dV/dt)c from 0.5 to 5 V/µs, while the maximum IGT, IH and IL rise with them. The spread of sensitivities is meant for gate drive straight from a microcontroller.

The 1 A rms rating assumes a full sine wave and holds up to a tab temperature of 90 °C on SOT-223, 107 °C on SMBflat-3L, and a lead temperature of 50 °C on TO-92; above those it falls to zero at 125 °C (Figure 2). In free air (Figure 3) a SOT-223 on 60 °C/W can carry 1 A up to about 50 °C ambient. Dissipation reaches about 1.26 W at 1 A (Figure 1). Copper under the case lowers Rth(j-a) on the surface-mount packages: about 60 °C/W for SOT-223 and 75 °C/W for SMBflat-3L at 5 cm² (Figure 12).

A single full cycle can carry 8 A peak at 50 Hz or 8.5 A at 60 Hz from a 25 °C start. The permitted peak falls as the number of cycles grows (Figure 7), and the repetitive curve at Tamb = 95 °C starts at about 2.5 A. The I²t for fusing is 0.35 A²s at 10 ms. For a single sinusoidal pulse (Figure 8), ITSM falls from about 80 A at 13 µs to about 8.5 A at 10 ms, and I²t is 0.35 A²s from 1 to 10 ms; below about 16 µs the 20 A/µs dI/dt limit bounds the peak.

Turn-off is specified by (dV/dt)c at a falling current slope (dI/dt)c of 0.44 A/ms and Tj = 110 °C. A slower voltage rise lets the triac commutate a steeper current fall (Figure 10); the permitted (dI/dt)c also grows as the junction cools, to about 5.6 times its value at the specified junction temperature when Tj is 0 °C (Figure 11).

operation.topic: Temperature dependence of gate and holding figures
operation.text: Relative to 25 °C, IGT, IH and IL rise to between about 1.7 and 2.4 times near -40 °C and fall to about 0.27 to 0.42 times at 125 °C (Figures 5 and 6). VGT changes less: about 1.2 times near -40 °C and 0.63 times at 125 °C. Static dV/dt immunity is about 6 times higher at 25 °C than at 125 °C (Figure 13).

The moulding epoxy meets UL94 V0 and all packages are lead-free. The SOT-223 and SMBflat-3L land patterns overlap so one board pattern takes either: the SMBflat-3L tab sits on the SOT-223 tab land (both A2), and its two small leads join SOT-223 pins 1 (A1) and 3 (G) through connector traces (Figure 17).
